title: Transit Manggarai
genre: Indonesian art rock with tribal percussion
subject: changing trains at Manggarai station at seven in the morning, pushed up the stairs by the crowd while holding a box of birthday cake for a colleague
caption: Indonesian art rock with tribal percussion, in the Barasuara arena style. Two interlocking electric guitars, one clean and arpeggiated, one overdriven and chugging; a stack of floor toms and tribal toms pounding in unison patterns; a driving eighth-note electric bass; a low synth drone holding the root. Wide and loud, drums huge and roomy, guitars split left and right, raw live-band feel. Male and female lead voices trading lines in an urgent rhythmic mid-range, a shouted gang vocal on the chorus. 150 BPM, E minor. Breathless, tense, stubbornly funny. No pop-punk power chords, no metal growls, no autotune, no EDM drop, no ballad breakdown.
lyrics:
[Intro - pounding toms and guitar arpeggio]

[Verse 1]
Jam tujuh lewat lima, pintu kereta terbuka
Aku keluar bukan jalan, aku keluar didorong
Kotak kue di tangan kanan, tulisan Selamat Ultah Bu Wati
Tangga naik ke peron enam, semua orang lari

[Pre-Chorus]
Jangan miring, jangan miring
Krimnya udah nempel di plastik

[Chorus]
Manggarai, Manggarai, tahan napas, tahan kotak
Ribuan bahu, satu arah, satu tangga yang sesak
Manggarai, Manggarai, kakiku nggak napak lantai
Pintu kereta ke Bekasi nutup, aku pas di dalam

[Verse 2]
Bapak di depan bawa galon, ibu di belakang bawa tikar
Petugas teriak, Ikuti jalur, kuning di kanan
Ada anak kecil tidur di bahu ayahnya
Dia satu-satunya yang santai di sini

[Pre-Chorus]
Jangan miring, jangan miring
Lilinnya patah, nggak apa-apa

[Chorus]
Manggarai, Manggarai, tahan napas, tahan kotak
Ribuan bahu, satu arah, satu tangga yang sesak
Manggarai, Manggarai, kotaknya penyok di pojok
Bu Wati nanti ketawa, kuenya tetep enak

[Outro - toms alone, then one guitar chord]
Jam delapan kurang lima, kotaknya kubuka
Tulisannya tinggal Selamat Bu
